candidate.answerReason: The positive factors of 36 that are multiples of 4 are 4, 12, and 36.

methods.label: List factor pairs
methods.explanation:
Every factor pair of \(36\) has a member at most \(6\), since two numbers greater than \(6\) would have a product greater than \(36\). Testing \(1\) through \(6\) gives all the pairs:
\[
1\times36,\quad 2\times18,\quad 3\times12,\quad 4\times9,\quad 6\times6.
\]
Among the factors in these pairs, exactly \(4,12,36\) are multiples of \(4\). There are \(3\), so the answer is \(\boxed{3}\), choice B.
